description: Retrieval-quality corpus for the memory recall pipeline (spec 08 §6) -- X-010. No retrieval-quality (Hit@K/MRR) benchmark existed for memory recall before this fixture; cargo xtask memory-bench (fixtures/memory/index.json) scores the consolidation router, not recall. Each entry/query carries an original-language variant (as a real user would write it) and a hand-translated English variant, so cargo xtask memory-recall-bench can compare the as-is pipeline against English-normalized configurations (X-011). Content is fictional (a made-up 'Aurora' telemetry-pipeline project) so it cannot be confused with this repository's own history. lang_pair on each query records (entry_language, query_language): ru-ru/en-en are same-language controls, ru-en/en-ru are the cross-lingual cases the normalization question is actually about.

entries.text_original: Для фьюжна поиска в Aurora остановились на RRF с k=45 вместо дефолтных 60 -- на прогоне бенчмарка k=60 давал MRR на 0.03 хуже из-за того, что лексическая нога слишком долго доминировала над dense-ногой на коротких запросах.
entries.text_english: For Aurora's search fusion we settled on RRF with k=45 instead of the default 60 -- at k=60 the benchmark run scored 0.03 lower on MRR because the lexical leg kept dominating the dense leg for too long on short queries.

entries.text_original: Флейковость в CI у Aurora объяснилась не гонкой в тестах, а тем, что Spotlight-индексатор macOS перехватывает exec каждого тестового бинарника на self-hosted раннере и подвешивает его на несколько секунд.
entries.text_english: Aurora's CI flakiness turned out not to be a test race at all -- macOS's Spotlight indexer intercepts every test binary's exec on the self-hosted runner and stalls it for several seconds.

entries.text_original: В Aurora каждое сообщение коммита обязано ссылаться на тикет вида AURA-NNN в первой строке, иначе pre-commit хук его отклоняет.
entries.text_english: In Aurora, every commit message must reference a ticket in the AURA-NNN form on its first line, or the pre-commit hook rejects it.

entries.text_original: Кэш ответов в Aurora сделали на LRU с бюджетом 512 МБ, а не на LFU -- LFU при пиковой нагрузке слишком долго держал горячие ключи прошлого инцидента и не давал вытеснить их даже после того, как трафик на них исчез.
entries.text_english: Aurora's response cache uses LRU with a 512 MB budget instead of LFU -- under peak load LFU kept last incident's hot keys pinned far too long and never let them get evicted even after their traffic had disappeared.

entries.text_original: Сервис ingest-worker в Aurora падает с общим паникой без осмысленного кода ошибки, если на вход приходит пустой payload -- обработчик разыменовывает Option без проверки на None.
entries.text_english: Aurora's ingest-worker service panics with no meaningful error code when it receives an empty payload -- the handler dereferences an Option without checking for None first.

entries.text_original: Ротация учётных данных staging-базы в Aurora: сначала создать новый пароль в секрет-хранилище с суффиксом -next, прогнать деплой с двумя валидными паролями одновременно, и только потом отозвать старый через 24 часа.
entries.text_english: Rotating Aurora's staging database credentials: first create a new password in the secret store with a -next suffix, deploy with both passwords valid at once, and only revoke the old one 24 hours later.

entries.text_original: До конца третьего квартала нужно перевести legacy-сервис report-gen в Aurora с Python 2 на Python 3, иначе он останется без патчей безопасности после снятия поддержки у базового образа.
entries.text_english: By the end of Q3, Aurora's legacy report-gen service must move off Python 2 onto Python 3, or it will stop receiving security patches once the base image drops support.

entries.text_original: Подозреваем, что утечка памяти в session-cache Aurora вызвана незакрытыми WebSocket-хендлами -- количество открытых файловых дескрипторов растёт линейно с числом реконнектов клиента, а не с числом активных сессий.
entries.text_english: We suspect the memory leak in Aurora's session-cache comes from unclosed WebSocket handles -- the open file descriptor count grows linearly with client reconnects, not with the number of active sessions.

entries.text_original: Aurora's API gateway rate-limits with a token bucket, 100 requests per second per client, chosen over a sliding window because it tolerates short legitimate bursts from batch clients without needing a separate burst allowance config.
entries.text_english: Aurora's API gateway rate-limits with a token bucket, 100 requests per second per client, chosen over a sliding window because it tolerates short legitimate bursts from batch clients without needing a separate burst allowance config.

entries.text_original: The billing-exporter job in Aurora silently drops rows once the generated CSV exceeds 2 GB -- the writer hits a platform file-size limit and swallows the resulting error instead of failing the job.
entries.text_english: The billing-exporter job in Aurora silently drops rows once the generated CSV exceeds 2 GB -- the writer hits a platform file-size limit and swallows the resulting error instead of failing the job.

entries.text_original: Every Terraform module in Aurora must pin its provider version exactly (no ~> ranges) -- an unpinned provider once auto-upgraded mid-apply and silently changed the default encryption setting on a new bucket.
entries.text_english: Every Terraform module in Aurora must pin its provider version exactly (no ~> ranges) -- an unpinned provider once auto-upgraded mid-apply and silently changed the default encryption setting on a new bucket.

entries.text_original: For the CDC pipeline, Aurora picked PostgreSQL logical replication over Debezium -- Debezium's Kafka Connect dependency would have added a whole cluster to operate for a pipeline that only ever needs one downstream consumer.
entries.text_english: For the CDC pipeline, Aurora picked PostgreSQL logical replication over Debezium -- Debezium's Kafka Connect dependency would have added a whole cluster to operate for a pipeline that only ever needs one downstream consumer.

entries.text_original: Aurora's auth-service returns HTTP 500 instead of 401 when a JWT is well-formed but expired -- the expiry check throws before the handler's own error mapper gets a chance to translate it.
entries.text_english: Aurora's auth-service returns HTTP 500 instead of 401 when a JWT is well-formed but expired -- the expiry check throws before the handler's own error mapper gets a chance to translate it.

entries.text_original: To roll back a failed canary deploy of Aurora's checkout-api: freeze the canary's traffic weight at 0 first, wait for in-flight requests to drain, then delete the canary revision -- deleting it before freezing traffic drops in-flight checkouts.
entries.text_english: To roll back a failed canary deploy of Aurora's checkout-api: freeze the canary's traffic weight at 0 first, wait for in-flight requests to drain, then delete the canary revision -- deleting it before freezing traffic drops in-flight checkouts.

entries.text_original: Add OpenTelemetry tracing to Aurora's notification-dispatcher service -- right now an incident review has no way to tell which upstream event triggered a given outbound notification.
entries.text_english: Add OpenTelemetry tracing to Aurora's notification-dispatcher service -- right now an incident review has no way to tell which upstream event triggered a given outbound notification.

entries.text_original: The Friday p99 latency spike on Aurora's API gateway is suspected to correlate with the weekly analytics batch job, which reads from the same read replica the gateway's cache-miss path falls back to.
entries.text_english: The Friday p99 latency spike on Aurora's API gateway is suspected to correlate with the weekly analytics batch job, which reads from the same read replica the gateway's cache-miss path falls back to.

entries.text_original: Команда договорилась не хранить refresh_token в LocalStorage фронтенда Aurora, только в httpOnly cookie -- после аудита выяснилось, что любой подключённый браузерный расширение мог прочитать LocalStorage целиком.
entries.text_english: The team agreed not to store refresh_token in Aurora's frontend LocalStorage, only in an httpOnly cookie -- an audit found that any installed browser extension could read all of LocalStorage.

entries.text_original: Очередь уведомлений в Aurora решили перевести с RabbitMQ на NATS JetStream -- повторные доставки из dead-letter очереди RabbitMQ дублировали уведомления пользователям вместо того, чтобы просто логировать сбой.
entries.text_english: Aurora's notification queue is moving from RabbitMQ to NATS JetStream -- redeliveries out of RabbitMQ's dead-letter queue were duplicating user-facing notifications instead of just logging the failure.

entries.text_original: В сервисе pdf-render Aurora нашли баг: кириллические имена файлов ломают вложения в письмах, потому что заголовок Content-Disposition кодируется без RFC 5987 percent-encoding.
entries.text_english: A bug was found in Aurora's pdf-render service: Cyrillic file names break email attachments because the Content-Disposition header is encoded without RFC 5987 percent-encoding.

entries.text_original: Все миграции схемы в Aurora обязаны быть обратимыми -- down-миграция это не опциональная часть PR, ревьюер отклоняет любую миграцию без неё, даже если откат кажется маловероятным.
entries.text_english: Every schema migration in Aurora must be reversible -- a down-migration is not an optional part of the PR, and a reviewer rejects any migration that lacks one, even when a rollback seems unlikely.

entries.text_original: The team picked feature flags via LaunchDarkly for Aurora instead of a home-grown config service -- the home-grown option would have needed its own audit trail and staged-rollout UI, which LaunchDarkly already ships.
entries.text_english: The team picked feature flags via LaunchDarkly for Aurora instead of a home-grown config service -- the home-grown option would have needed its own audit trail and staged-rollout UI, which LaunchDarkly already ships.

entries.text_original: Aurora's search-indexer re-embeds every document on a config reload, even documents whose content did not change at all -- the reload path never checks the existing embedding's content hash before recomputing it.
entries.text_english: Aurora's search-indexer re-embeds every document on a config reload, even documents whose content did not change at all -- the reload path never checks the existing embedding's content hash before recomputing it.

entries.text_original: To request a temporary elevated role in Aurora's admin panel: open a request against the on-call approver, state the exact action and a time-box, and the role auto-revokes at the time-box's end even if nobody remembers to revoke it manually.
entries.text_english: To request a temporary elevated role in Aurora's admin panel: open a request against the on-call approver, state the exact action and a time-box, and the role auto-revokes at the time-box's end even if nobody remembers to revoke it manually.

entries.text_original: Onboarding drop-off in Aurora is suspected to come from the mandatory SSO step timing out over VPN -- the timeout is fixed at 8 seconds, and VPN-routed identity-provider round trips regularly run longer than that.
